Reach for this skill when building SKILL.md files, testing skill descriptions, bundling scripts, or implementing skills support in an agent client. metadata: mintlify-proj: agent version: "1.0" --- # Agent Skills ## Product summary Agent Skills is an open format for packaging specialized knowledge and workflows into portable, version-controlled folders that AI agents load on demand. A skill is a directory containing a `SKILL.md` file (metadata + instructions) plus optional scripts, references, and assets. Agents discover skills at startup, load only the name and description initially, and pull full instructions when a task matches the skill's scope. This progressive disclosure keeps context efficient while giving agents access to domain expertise, repeatable workflows, and cross-product reuse.
